_help.expected_pads: number of pads in the column (0 = unknown); used to pick the right column
_help.pad_sizes_um: design pad sizes [x, y] in um, x = horizontal in the image; one entry per pad type
_help.pad_size_tolerance_um: a pad is size_ok if measured x and y are within this of a design size
_help.min_mark_diameter_um: smallest real needle mark: a circle of this diameter (area, width and height)
_help.method: pad segmentation: gray / chroma / black / bgdiff, or auto (try all); pin the one reported in the JSON
_help.polarity: pads are the dark or light class: dark / light / auto
_help.column_tolerance: max sideways shift between consecutive pads, x pad width
_help.edge_px: pad border ignored, in px (blurred pad edge); a mark reaching it is at_edge
_help.min_contrast: a pixel stands out from the pad above this colour distance (0..441) ...
_help.noise_k: ... and above the pad's own noise by this many sigmas. Raise both to shrink boxes / drop specks
_help.peak_factor: a region is a mark only if its peak reaches this x the reference threshold. LOWER = accept fainter marks
_help.peak_reference: reference threshold for peak_factor: image = median over all pads (robust to noisy pads), pad = each pad's own
_help.min_clearance_um: at_edge also for marks closer than this to the pad edge; 0 = only marks reaching the edge
_help.um_per_px: force the pixel size; null = from the TIFF tags, else estimated from the pads
